text:
There are no National Register Historical sites in the immediate area of the proposed improvement. However, there is one site of local historic interest north of Lincoln Highway along Chicago Road within the Woodrow Wilson Forest Preserve. This site, the spot where the first white settler in this part of Cook County built his cabin, will not be affected by this project.
There should be no impact on any ecological or scenic resources in the area.
The improvement should not alter the pattern of behavior for any known genus or species.
There are no important breeding, nesting, or feeding grounds in the area of the proposed improvement.
